issues.where: the three pale ribbons streaming right from the sea stack
issues.what: they read as flat translucent cut-out cards with hard jagged edges, uniform lilac tint and no volume; they also cross in front of the far stacks with no depth or atmospheric falloff
issues.fix: replace with volumetric spray or cloud with soft edges, internal density variation and light from the lightning

issues.where: lightning strike point at the summit of the main stack
issues.what: the white glow and spark burst light nothing: the rock face below, the ribbons and the cloud base right next to it stay the same dull tone; the bolt is a thin 2D line
issues.fix: let the strike throw a strong flash onto the summit rock, the nearby cloud and the ribbons, and add bloom and branching falloff to the bolt

issues.where: left edge and base of the main sea stack
issues.what: silhouette is stair-stepped and wavy like an extruded or displaced mesh, and the base dissolves into a smeared reflection with no surf, foam or wet line where rock meets sea
issues.fix: give the stack a natural fractured silhouette and add breaking surf, foam and a wet dark band at the waterline

issues.where: the shaggy animal in the centre and its legs
issues.what: the coat is a stack of flat feather-like cards with hard planar edges; the feet show no contact with the ice, no shadow pooled under the body, and no snow or frost on it; a cluster of black spiky strands at its rear looks like a geometry error
issues.fix: use real strand fur with clumping, plant the feet with contact shadow and snow disturbance, add frost, and remove the black spike cluster

issues.where: the two cut-out mountains and the misty shape through the cave mouth
issues.what: the far peaks are flat-lit cut-outs with no aerial perspective, a translucent ghostly shape overlaps them like a mis-layered card, and the orange sunset sits behind a night storm sky that does not light the snow
issues.fix: add atmospheric haze and scale cues to the distance, remove the ghost shape, and reconcile sky and ground lighting

issues.where: cave walls and roof (crops x 0-17%, 42-58%, 83-100% at y 25-42%)
issues.what: rock texture is smeared and stretched along the surface into streaky brush-like strokes, reading as a projected or stretched texture rather than ice or stone
issues.fix: re-texture the cave with proper UVs or triplanar mapping and real ice or rock detail at close range

issues.where: the frosted plants or creatures at lower left (crop x 0-17%, y 58-75%)
issues.what: they are made of the same flat feather cards as the animal, with clipped hard edges and a crinkled bump texture stamped uniformly on every blade
issues.fix: vary the geometry and material and add translucency and frost build-up

issues.where: snow bank at right and the ice floor
issues.what: snow is smooth plastic-like with no grain, sparkle or footprints, and the ice floor reflects nothing of the bright cave mouth or the lightning
issues.fix: add snow grain and specular sparkle, and reflections and light spill from the opening onto the floor

issues.what: rock has a smooth, clay-like sheen with smeared stretched streaks, and the same material covers every stack
issues.fix: add sharp fracture detail, wet sheen variation, lichen or guano and per-stack material variety

issues.where: the small creature and the thin cords at the stack summit (crop x 42-58%, y 25-42%)
issues.what: a brown creature clings to taut straight cords that run into the flat ribbons, with spines regularly spaced like a copied pattern; the whole thing reads as a rig left in shot
issues.fix: remove the cords or make them a believable natural structure with irregular spacing, and integrate the creature with shadow and wet

issues.where: blurred foreground rock at left (crops x 0-17%)
issues.what: the defocus is a smooth even gaussian with no bokeh structure, and it shows a repeating blotch pattern at full size
issues.fix: use a physically based lens blur on a varied texture
